answer: Coordinated Touch Ledger. Each identity must periodically submit a fresh random challenge co-signed by five distinct peers, forming an unpredictable interaction pigment. Validators only count signatures whose signers also co-signed other challenges within the same window, so fake identities must sustain real pairwise work each epoch. A sybil cluster pays O(n²) signing and coordination overhead, while honest users pay O(n), making mass fakery an oasis of cost amid cheap genuine use; the horizon of profitable forgery recedes as clusters grow.
